fullPassage: See the Future in Movies Several artificial intelligence (AI) technologies described in films are now a reality. One of them is self-driving cars. In Total Recall, for example, the taxi driver is the vehicle’s computer system. The taxi is capable of driving itself without any human intervention. Having seen that movie, many people wanted self-driving cars. Luckily, self-driving cars are being developed and certain versions are already on the road. Additionally, many other AI technologies from movies are either in use or under development. 2001: A Space Odyssey This movie, set in 2001, realistically describes a group of scientists on a spaceship heading to another planet. However, it was released in 1968, a year prior to the first moon landing. This means that human imagination goes far beyond reality. In the movie, the ship has a computer system, called “HAL-9000.” It provided the audience with the chance to understand AI. It could operate and regulate all of the spacecraft’s systems and help the astronauts conduct experiments by analyzing data. In one scene, the astronauts and HAL-9000 carry out a conversation about a faulty component of the spacecraft. Then, HAL-9000 makes a recommendation for the next step. The system could even draw logical conclusions and evaluate its decisions. The AI helper for a spaceship, which was only seen in the film at the time, has become a reality. In 2008, the International Space Station, a large spacecraft orbiting Earth, started to use an AI robot named CIMON. It is a floating spherical robot that can move around inside the spacecraft. CIMON, weighing only 5 kg, serves as a competent AI assistant for astronauts. The robot assists astronauts in more effectively accomplishing complex tasks by offering advice during experiments and work. It is also able to record and film the astronauts’ activities when asked. Minority Report Minority Report, a film set in the year 2050, was released in 2002. It features AI-based advertisements that can identify individuals from a remote distance by scanning people’s eyes. There is a scene where the main character enters a shopping mall. After scanning him and identifying who he is, the advertising system offers products that may be appealing to him. Nowadays, we frequently encounter personalized advertisements provided by AI. For instance, many online shopping malls, platforms for sharing videos, and social media use AI. Their AI systems provide us with advertisements based on our previous searches or other online behavior. Regarding the technology identifying people through scanning eyes, some devices have already been developed. However, those that do not use AI technology have a critical limitation. They can identify a person only if he or she is standing still. On the other hand, devices employing AI have overcome this limitation. They can scan people’s eyes when they are walking. There has been continuous development of this technology up until now. Big Hero 6 This is a science fiction animation that was released in 2014. There is a scene in the movie where a boy meets Baymax, a personal medical aid AI robot. The robot scans the boy’s body to detect potential health problems using its sensors and cameras. What it discovers within seconds is a wound in his arm. It administers medicine on the wound. In another scene where he has a mood swing, Baymax checks his hormone levels to determine the cause of his mood swing. These days, AI-based programs or robots are widely used in the medical industry. Some AI programs have been refined to the point that they can not only identify cancer quickly and accurately, but also predict the chance of getting cancer. AI robots are also used in operating rooms. Based on the collected data, AI surgical robots can conduct cognitive activities such as voice recognition, decision-making, problem-solving, and more. Under the guidance and control of doctors, they can conduct elementary operations such as cutting and stitching patients undergoing surgery. Another example is the development of an AI system to forecast when a hospitalized patient’s condition is likely to get worse. It analyzes the patient’s profile and data and assigns scores indicating the need for transfer to an intensive care unit. The medical team intervenes when a patient’s scores reach a certain level. AI in movies and our future AI has been progressing rapidly over the years, and its potential is only beginning to be fully recognized. It is certain that AI will continue to play a significant role in more and more aspects of our lives. Accordingly, these days, a lot of movies feature various kinds of AI. Some AI robots have personalities and emotionally engage with people in the same way that humans do. Furthermore, some AI characters are physically indistinguishable from humans. These movies are not only fun to watch, but also inspiring. They show us what AI might be like in the future and how it could affect us. What AI technology from a movie do you think will be used in our lives in the future?

questions.passage: One of them is self-driving cars. In Total Recall, for example, the taxi driver is the vehicle’s computer system. The taxi is (A)[capable / afraid] of driving itself without any human intervention. Having seen that movie, many people (B)[wanted / avoided] self-driving cars. Luckily, self-driving cars are being (C)[developed / removed] and certain versions are already on the road.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ① capable(할 수 있는)+wanted(원했다)+developed(개발되는): 택시가 사람의 개입 없이 스스로 운전할 수 '있고', 그 영화를 본 사람들이 자율주행차를 '원했으며', 자율주행차가 '개발되고' 있다는 문맥에 모두 맞음 ← 정답
❌ ② afraid(두려워하는)는 스스로 운전할 수 '있다'는 문맥과 어긋남
❌ ③ avoided(피했다)는 자율주행차를 '원했다'는 문맥과 반대
❌ ④ removed(제거되는)는 자율주행차가 '개발되고' 있다는 문맥과 반대
det.tip: capable=할 수 있는, want=원하다, develop=개발하다

questions.passage: 2001: A Space Odyssey This movie, set in 2001, realistically describes a group of scientists on a spaceship heading to another planet. However, it was released in 1968, a year (A)[prior / subsequent] to the first moon landing. This means that human imagination goes far beyond reality. In the movie, the ship has a computer system, called “HAL-9000. ” It provided the audience with the chance to understand AI. It could operate and (B)[regulate / ignore] all of the spacecraft’s systems and help the astronauts conduct experiments by (C)[analyzing / deleting] data.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.analysis:
❌ ① subsequent(이후의)는 1968년이 첫 달 착륙보다 '이전'이라는 문맥과 반대
✅ ② prior(이전의)+regulate(조절하다)+analyzing(분석하는): 영화가 달 착륙 1년 '전에' 나왔고, HAL-9000이 시스템을 '조절'했으며, 데이터를 '분석해' 실험을 도왔다는 문맥에 모두 맞음 ← 정답
❌ ③ ignore(무시하다)는 시스템을 '조절'했다는 문맥과 반대
❌ ④ deleting(삭제하는)는 데이터를 '분석'했다는 문맥과 반대
det.tip: prior to=~ 이전에, regulate=조절하다, analyze=분석하다

questions.passage: In 2008, the International Space Station, a large spacecraft orbiting Earth, started to use an AI robot named CIMON. It is a floating spherical robot that can move around inside the spacecraft. CIMON, weighing only 5 kg, serves as a (A)[competent / clumsy] AI assistant for astronauts. The robot (B)[assists / prevents] astronauts in more effectively accomplishing (C)[complex / simple] tasks by offering advice during experiments and work.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.analysis:
❌ ① clumsy(서투른)는 '유능한' 조수 역할을 한다는 문맥과 반대
❌ ② prevents(막다)는 우주비행사를 '돕는다'는 문맥과 반대
❌ ③ simple(단순한)은 '복잡한' 임무를 더 효과적으로 완수하도록 돕는다는 문맥과 반대
✅ ④ competent(유능한)+assists(돕는다)+complex(복잡한): CIMON이 '유능한' 조수로서 우주비행사를 '돕고', '복잡한' 임무를 더 효과적으로 완수하게 한다는 문맥에 모두 맞음 ← 정답
det.tip: competent=유능한, assist=돕다, complex=복잡한

questions.passage: Minority Report Minority Report, a film set in the year 2050, was released in 2002.  It features AI-based advertisements that can ①<u>identify</u> individuals from a remote distance by scanning people’s eyes.  There is a scene where the main character enters a shopping mall.  After scanning him and identifying who he is, the advertising system offers products that may be ②<u>appealing</u> to him.  Nowadays, we frequently encounter ③<u>random</u> advertisements provided by AI.  For instance, many online shopping malls, platforms for sharing videos, and social media use AI.  Their AI systems provide us with advertisements based on our ④<u>previous</u> searches or other online behavior.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ③ random → personalized: 검색 기록에 기반한 '맞춤형' 광고
det.analysis:
✅ ① identify: AI 광고가 사람을 '식별할' 수 있다는 문맥에 적절
✅ ② appealing: 광고 시스템이 그에게 '매력적일' 만한 상품을 제안한다는 문맥에 적절
❌ ③ random(무작위의) → personalized(맞춤형의): 뒤에 '우리의 이전 검색 기록에 기반해' 광고를 제공한다고 했으므로 무작위가 아니라 '맞춤형' 광고여야 한다. random은 문맥과 반대 ← 정답
✅ ④ previous: 우리의 '이전' 검색 기록에 기반한다는 문맥에 적절
det.tip: based on our previous searches(이전 검색 기록 기반) → personalized(맞춤형), random 아님

questions.passage: Regarding the technology identifying people through scanning eyes, some devices have already been developed.  However, those that do not use AI technology have a ①<u>critical</u> limitation.  They can identify a person only if he or she is standing ②<u>still</u>.  On the other hand, devices employing AI have ③<u>worsened</u> this limitation.  They can scan people’s eyes when they are walking.  There has been ④<u>continuous</u> development of this technology up until now.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ③ worsened → overcome: AI 기기가 이 한계를 '극복했다'
det.analysis:
✅ ① critical: AI 기술을 쓰지 않는 기기는 '중대한' 한계가 있다는 문맥에 적절
✅ ② still: 사람이 가만히 '멈춰 있어야만' 식별할 수 있다는 문맥에 적절
❌ ③ worsened(악화시켰다) → overcome(극복했다): 뒤에 AI 기기는 걸을 때도 눈을 스캔할 수 있다고 했으므로 한계를 '극복한' 것이다. worsened는 정반대 ← 정답
✅ ④ continuous: 지금까지 이 기술의 '지속적인' 발전이 있었다는 문맥에 적절
det.tip: can scan when walking(걸을 때도 스캔) → overcome(극복하다), worsened 아님

questions.passage: There is a scene in the movie where a boy meets Baymax, a personal medical aid AI robot.  The robot scans the boy’s body to ①<u>detect</u> potential health problems using its sensors and cameras.  What it ②<u>conceals</u> within seconds is a wound in his arm.  It administers medicine on the wound.  In another scene where he has a mood swing, Baymax checks his hormone levels to ③<u>determine</u> the cause of his mood swing.  These days, AI-based programs or robots are widely used in the medical industry.  Some AI programs have been refined to the point that they can not only identify cancer quickly and accurately, but also ④<u>predict</u> the chance of getting cancer.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ② conceals → discovers: 로봇이 몇 초 만에 상처를 '발견한다'
det.analysis:
✅ ① detect: 로봇이 잠재적 건강 문제를 '감지하기' 위해 몸을 스캔한다는 문맥에 적절
❌ ② conceals(숨기다) → discovers(발견하다): 로봇이 몸을 스캔해 몇 초 만에 팔의 상처를 찾아낸다는 흐름이므로 '발견하다'가 맞다. conceals는 정반대 ← 정답
✅ ③ determine: 기분 변화의 원인을 '알아내기' 위해 호르몬 수치를 확인한다는 문맥에 적절
✅ ④ predict: 암에 걸릴 가능성을 '예측한다'는 문맥에 적절
det.tip: scans the body → a wound(상처를 찾아냄) → discovers(발견하다), conceals 아님

questions.passage: 2001: A Space Odyssey This movie, set in 2001, realistically describes a group of scientists on a spaceship heading to another planet.  However, it was released in 1968, a year prior to the first moon landing.  This means that human __________ goes far beyond reality.  In the movie, the ship has a computer system, called “HAL-9000.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ① imagination(상상력): 영화가 첫 달 착륙보다 1년 앞선 1968년에 나왔다는 앞 내용은, 인간의 '상상력'이 현실을 훨씬 앞선다는 뜻으로 이어짐 ← 정답
❌ ② memory(기억): 현실을 앞서간다는 문맥과 어울리지 않음
❌ ③ patience(인내심): 문맥과 무관함
❌ ④ laughter(웃음): 문맥과 무관함
det.tip: human imagination goes far beyond reality(상상력이 현실을 앞서다)

questions.passage: Based on the collected data, AI surgical robots can conduct cognitive activities such as voice recognition, decision-making, problem-solving, and more.  Under the guidance and control of doctors, they can conduct elementary operations such as cutting and stitching patients undergoing surgery.  Another example is the development of an AI system to __________ when a hospitalized patient’s condition is likely to get worse.  It analyzes the patient’s profile and data and assigns scores indicating the need for transfer to an intensive care unit.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:
❌ ① celebrate(축하하다): 환자 상태와 무관함
❌ ② ignore(무시하다): 환자 상태를 감시·대응하는 시스템의 목적과 반대
❌ ③ record(기록하다): 이미 일어난 일을 적는다는 뜻이라 '언제 나빠질지' 미리 판단하는 흐름과 어긋남
✅ ④ forecast(예측하다): 입원 환자의 상태가 언제 나빠질지 미리 '예측하는' AI 시스템이라는 문맥에 적절하며, 뒤에 점수를 매겨 중환자실 이송 필요를 판단한다는 내용과 이어짐 ← 정답
det.tip: an AI system to forecast when ... is likely to get worse(언제 나빠질지 예측하다)

questions.passage: There is a scene where the main character enters a shopping mall.  After scanning him and identifying who he is, the advertising system offers products that may be appealing to him.  Nowadays, we frequently __________ personalized advertisements provided by AI.  For instance, many online shopping malls, platforms for sharing videos, and social media use AI.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:
❌ ① produce(생산하다): 광고를 만드는 것은 AI 시스템이지 소비자인 우리가 아님
✅ ② encounter(마주치다): 요즘 우리가 AI가 제공하는 맞춤형 광고를 자주 '마주친다'는 문맥에 적절하며, 뒤에 온라인 쇼핑몰·영상 공유 플랫폼이 AI를 쓴다는 예시와 이어짐 ← 정답
❌ ③ translate(번역하다): 문맥과 무관함
❌ ④ delete(삭제하다): 광고를 접한다는 흐름과 반대
det.tip: we frequently encounter personalized advertisements(맞춤형 광고를 자주 마주치다)

questions.passage: There is a scene in the movie where a boy meets Baymax, a personal medical aid AI robot.  The robot scans the boy’s body to <u>detect</u> potential health problems using its sensors and cameras.  What it discovers within seconds is a wound in his arm.  It administers medicine on the wound.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 detect와 의미가 가장 가까운 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ① find: 찾아내다, 발견하다 ← 정답. 로봇이 센서와 카메라로 잠재적 건강 문제를 '감지·발견한다'는 문맥과 같음
❌ ② hide: 숨기다 (정반대)
❌ ③ create: 만들다 (관련 없음)
❌ ④ forget: 잊다 (관련 없음)
det.tip: detect potential health problems = find(문제를 찾아내다)

questions.passage: In 2008, the International Space Station, a large spacecraft orbiting Earth, started to use an AI robot named CIMON.  It is a floating spherical robot that can move around inside the spacecraft.  CIMON, weighing only 5 kg, serves as a competent AI assistant for astronauts.  The robot assists astronauts in more effectively <u>accomplishing</u> complex tasks by offering advice during experiments and work.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 accomplishing와 의미가 가장 가까운 것은?

det.analysis:

❌ ② delaying: 미루다 (반대 방향)
✅ ③ completing: 완수하다, 끝마치다 ← 정답. 복잡한 임무를 더 효과적으로 '완수하도록' 돕는다는 문맥과 같음
❌ ④ forgetting: 잊다 (관련 없음)
det.tip: accomplishing complex tasks = completing(임무를 완수하다)

questions.passage: AI in movies and our future AI has been progressing rapidly over the years, and its potential is only beginning to be fully recognized.  It is certain that AI will continue to play a <u>significant</u> role in more and more aspects of our lives.  Accordingly, these days, a lot of movies feature various kinds of AI.  Some AI robots have personalities and emotionally engage with people in the same way that humans do.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 significant와 의미가 가장 가까운 것은?

det.analysis:
❌ ① minor: 사소한 (정반대)
❌ ② strange: 이상한 (관련 없음)
❌ ③ boring: 지루한 (관련 없음)
✅ ④ important: 중요한 ← 정답. AI가 우리 삶의 더 많은 부분에서 '중요한' 역할을 계속 하리라는 문맥과 같음
det.tip: play a significant role = important(중요한 역할)

questions.passage: AI in movies and our future AI has been progressing <u>rapidly</u> over the years, and its potential is only beginning to be fully recognized.  It is certain that AI will continue to play a significant role in more and more aspects of our lives.  Accordingly, these days, a lot of movies feature various kinds of AI.  Some AI robots have personalities and emotionally engage with people in the same way that humans do.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 rapidly와 의미가 가장 반대인 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ① slowly: 느리게 ← 정답. AI가 '빠르게(rapidly)' 발전해 왔다는 것의 반대
❌ ② quickly: 빠르게 (오히려 같은 뜻이라 반대가 아님)
❌ ③ suddenly: 갑자기 (속도가 아닌 급작스러움이라 의미축이 다름)
❌ ④ loudly: 크게(소리) (관련 없음)
det.tip: progressing rapidly(빠르게 발전) ↔ slowly(느리게)

questions.passage: Based on the collected data, AI surgical robots can conduct cognitive activities such as voice recognition, decision-making, problem-solving, and more.  Under the guidance and control of doctors, they can conduct elementary operations such as cutting and stitching patients undergoing surgery.  Another example is the development of an AI system to forecast when a hospitalized patient’s condition is likely to get <u>worse</u>. questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 worse와 의미가 가장 반대인 것은?

det.analysis:
❌ ① heavier: 더 무거운 (무게라 의미축이 다름)
❌ ② longer: 더 긴 (길이라 의미축이 다름)
❌ ③ stronger: 더 강한 (세기라 의미축이 다름)
✅ ④ better: 더 좋은, 더 나은 ← 정답. 환자의 상태가 '나빠질(get worse)' 때를 예측한다는 것의 반대
det.tip: condition is likely to get worse(상태가 나빠지다) ↔ better(나아지다)

questions.passage:
(A) The AI computer system on the spaceship could <u>operate</u> and regulate all of the machines automatically. It kept every part of the ship running smoothly without any human help.
(B) The skilled surgeon had to <u>operate</u> on the patient right away. She removed the tumor before it could spread further.
questions.stem: 다음 (A), (B) 두 문장에서 밑줄 친 operate의 의미로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ① (A) The AI computer system could operate and regulate all of the machines는 기계를 '작동시키고' 조절했다는 뜻이고, (B) The surgeon had to operate on the patient ... removed the tumor는 종양을 제거하려고 환자를 '수술했다'는 뜻 ← 정답
❌ ② (A)의 operate는 '수술하다'가 아니라 작동시키다
❌ ③ (A)의 operate는 '조종하다'가 아니라 기계를 작동시키다
❌ ④ (B)의 operate on a patient는 '운영하다'가 아니라 수술하다
det.tip: operate: (A) 작동시키다 / (B) (on+환자) 수술하다

questions.stem:
다음 영영 정의에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은?

"not working or made correctly; having a fault or defect"

det.analysis:
❌ ① logical: 논리적인 (사고와 관련, 결함과 무관)
❌ ② spherical: 구 모양의 (형태를 나타냄)
❌ ③ competent: 유능한 (능력을 나타냄)
✅ ④ faulty: 결함이 있는, 제대로 작동하지 않는 ← 정답. HAL-9000이 우주선의 '결함 있는' 부품에 관해 대화하는 장면이 그 예
det.tip: faulty = 결함이 있는(having a fault or defect)

questions.passage: CIMON, weighing only 5 kg, serves as a competent AI assistant for astronauts. The robot assists astronauts in more __________ (effective) accomplishing complex tasks by offering advice during experiments and work.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 (영어로) 쓰시오. (1단어)

det.analysis: effective(형용사, 효과적인) → effectively(부사, 효과적으로): 빈칸은 동사 accomplishing(완수하는)을 꾸미는 자리이므로 부사가 와야 한다. 'more effectively(더 효과적으로) 완수한다'는 뜻이 되도록 형용사 effective를 부사 effectively로 바꾼다.
det.tip: accomplishing(동사)을 꾸미는 자리 → 부사 effectively

questions.passage: AI robots are also used in operating rooms. Based on the collected data, AI surgical robots can conduct cognitive activities such as voice __________ (recognize), decision-making, problem-solving, and more.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 (영어로) 쓰시오. (1단어)

det.analysis: recognize(동사, 인식하다) → recognition(명사, 인식): 빈칸은 명사 voice와 결합해 'voice ___(음성 인식)'이라는 복합명사를 이루고, 뒤의 decision-making(의사결정)·problem-solving(문제해결) 같은 명사들과 병렬로 나열되므로 명사가 와야 한다. 동사 recognize를 명사 recognition으로 바꾼다.
det.tip: voice ___(복합명사) + decision-making 병렬 → 명사 recognition

questions.passage: However, those that do not use AI technology have a critical limitation.  They can identify a person only if he or she is __________.  On the other hand, devices employing AI have overcome this limitation.  They can scan people’s eyes when they are walking.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:
❌ ① walking fast(빠르게 걷는): 뒤에 AI 기기는 '걸을 때도' 스캔할 수 있다고 대비되므로, AI를 안 쓰는 기기는 걷는 상태에서는 못 한다
✅ ② standing still(가만히 멈춰 있는): AI를 쓰지 않는 기기는 사람이 '가만히 멈춰 있어야만' 식별할 수 있다는 뜻으로, 걸을 때도 스캔하는 AI 기기와 자연스럽게 대비됨 ← 정답
❌ ③ closing them(눈을 감는): 눈을 스캔한다는 내용과 반대
❌ ④ looking away(시선을 돌리는): 눈 스캔 문맥과 어울리지 않음
det.tip: AI 기기는 walking(걸을 때)도 스캔 ↔ 비AI 기기는 standing still(멈춰 있어야만)

questions.passage: It could operate and regulate all of the spacecraft’s systems and help the astronauts conduct experiments by analyzing data.  In one scene, the astronauts and HAL-9000 carry out a conversation about a faulty component of the spacecraft.  Then, HAL-9000 makes a recommendation for the next step.  The system could even draw __________ and evaluate its decisions.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:
❌ ① random guesses(무작위 추측): HAL-9000이 추천을 하고 판단을 평가하는 지적 능력과 반대
❌ ② physical objects(물리적 사물): 결론을 도출한다는 사고 활동과 무관함
✅ ③ logical conclusions(논리적 결론): 다음 단계를 추천하고 자신의 결정을 평가하는 시스템이 '논리적 결론'까지 도출할 수 있었다는 문맥에 적절 ← 정답
❌ ④ personal feelings(개인적 감정): 컴퓨터 시스템의 논리적 판단과 어울리지 않음
det.tip: makes a recommendation ... evaluate its decisions(추천·판단 평가) → draw logical conclusions(논리적 결론 도출)
